description: Known Go player-facing strings with no C source and no world-data source. make string-census fails when a new one appears; each reason starts unreviewed and is settled by a human (data-driven text, transport framing, deliberate post-C addition, or a bug).

!! The MUD server is performing a gracef.segment: !! The MUD server is performing a graceful shutdown for maintenance. Your state has been saved. !!
!! The MUD server is performing a gracef.evidence: src/act.wizard.c:1099 "Shutting down for maintenance.\r\n" — OS SIGINT/SIGTERM path cmd/server/main.go:874,971; in-game shutdown uses C do_shutdown's own bytes; trigger is the OS SIGINT/SIGTERM path, but a telnet player reads the bytes, so R4 applies; C's only shutdown text is the in-game do_shutdown line quoted here

A bat swoops down and attacks you!.segment: A bat swoops down and attacks you!
A bat swoops down and attacks you!.evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1780 "$n swoops down, narrowly missing your face." — C bat proc emotes this on random pulses; Go re-words it into an attack on look dripping

A magical force prevents you from castin.segment: A magical force prevents you from casting here.
A magical force prevents you from castin.evidence: src/spell_parser.c:419 "Your magic fizzles out and dies.\r\n" — NOMAGIC rejection slot of call_magic; Go invents wording and drops the psionic variant at :423

A shimmering portal appears and sucks yo.segment: A shimmering portal appears and sucks you in!
A shimmering portal appears and sucks yo.evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1665 "\r\nWith a blinding flash of light and a crack of thunder, you are" — C portal_room tells the victim this on teleport; Go re-words it and teleports on movement

Auto-loot disabled..evidence: src/act.other.c:1363 "You will no longer loot corpses.\r\n" — C toggle loot-off line; Go's port-only autoloot command rewords it

Auto-loot enabled..evidence: src/act.other.c:1368 "You will now automatically loot corpses.\r\n" — C toggle loot-on line; Go's port-only autoloot command rewords it

Broadcast what?.evidence: src/act.wizard.c:1697 "That must be a mistake...\r\n" — C has no broadcast command; its global-message cmd do_gecho prints this for an empty argument

Cannot access manager state..evidence: src/act.wizard.c:1788 "The game is %s completely open.\r\n" — C do_wizlock has no nil-manager guard; it prints the wizlock status line

Error looking up player..evidence: src/new_cmds.c:1415 "There is no such player.\r\n" — C do_whois loads the save file and prints this; the DB-error line is Go-only

Error saving aliases..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/interpreter.c:1013 — C do_alias prints only "Alias deleted."/"Alias added."; alias save errors are SYSERR-log only

Guest accounts are restricted from using.segment: Guest accounts are restricted from using this command.
Guest accounts are restricted from using.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/interpreter.c:310 — Guest login is port-only (session_login.go:84); C cmd_info has no account gate

Nice try..evidence: DP-1373, approved by Zach 2026-09-30: C src/spec_procs.c:2081-2126 grants Serapis/Orodreth level 40 and Frontline 39 on "pray immortality" (a name-based backdoor). The port refuses those names with this line instead and changes nothing.

No objects found..evidence: src/act.wizard.c:3329 "Sorry, there are no objs in that zone.\r\n" — C do_olist's no-results line; Go rewords it

No parsed world available..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.wizard.c:3336 — Go nil-parsed-world guard in rlist/olist/mlist; C reads world data directly

Note limit reached. Type '@' on a new li.segment: Note limit reached. Type '@' on a new line to save.
Note limit reached. Type '@' on a new li.evidence: src/modify.c:147 "String too long.  Last line skipped.\r\n" — C's note-editor over-length line; Go rewords it, calling C silent

Note recorded..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/modify.c:218 — C playing_string_cleanup speaks only for mail; a finished note prints nothing

Nothing magical happens..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/spell_parser.c:660 — C's ITEM_SCROLL recite has no such pre-check; invalid spellnum is silently ignored (spell_parser.c:405)

Parsed world data not available..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.wizard.c:395 — Go nil-parsed-world guard in vnum; C do_vnum reads mob/obj protos directly

Player lookup not available..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/house.c:652 — C get_id_by_name always answers; the unwired-lookup branch is port-only

Room data not found..evidence: src/act.wizard.c:422 "Room name: %s%s%s\r\n" — C do_stat_room prints the report unconditionally; no room-not-found branch

Something went wrong. Your gold was not.segment: Something went wrong. Your gold was not donated.
Something went wrong. Your gold was not.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.item.c:453 — C perform_drop_gold moves the coins unconditionally; no failure line

Something went wrong. Your item was not.segment: Something went wrong. Your item was not donated.
Something went wrong. Your item was not.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.item.c:510 — C perform_drop moves the item unconditionally; no failure line

That information is not available right.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.informative.c:2137 — C do_gen_ps pages the boot-loaded file; an unreadable file prints nothing

The bats swarm around you, blocking your.segment: The bats swarm around you, blocking your escape!
The bats swarm around you, blocking your.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/spec_procs2.c:1756 — C bat_room only wakes sleeping bats (Your movements wake up $n!); no blocking branch

The boy smiles and hands you a small not.segment: The boy smiles and hands you a small note.
The boy smiles and hands you a small not.evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1398 "$n exclaims, 'Don't let the bad man hurt me, mommy!" — C little_boy only exclaims this at random; the give-flower-for-note exchange is Go-only

The little boy runs off!.evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1398 "$n exclaims, 'Don't let the bad man hurt me, mommy!" — C little_boy never gives a note or leaves; the runs-off line is Go-only

Unknown channel..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.comm.c:1146 — C do_gen_comm takes subcmd from cmd_info; no unknown-channel text (cmdChannel callers pass fixed names)

Unknown toggle..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.other.c:1142 — C's toggles are separate cmd_info entries into do_gen_tog; no unknown-subcmd text

Usage: checkload { obj | mob } \u003cnum.evidence: src/act.wizard.c:3825 "Usage: checkload { obj | mob } <number>\r\n" — C holds it in a local const char* usage, invisible to the census sink lexer

Usage: olist \u003ckeyword\u003e.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.wizard.c:3304 — C do_olist has no usage line; its argument is a zone number, not a keyword

Usage: poofset \u003cin|out\u003e [messa.evidence: src/config.c:92 "Okay.\r\n" — no C poofset command; do_poofset (poofin/poofout) only replies OK

Usage: unaffect \u003cplayer\u003e.evidence: src/act.wizard.c:2091 "Yes, but for whom?!?\r\n" — C unaffect with no target prints this; Go prints a usage line instead

World not available..evidence: src/act.wizard.c:422 "Room name: %s%s%s\r\n" — Go nil-world guards in stat room/obj and vnum; C reads world[] and prints the report

You are Rank.evidence: src/clan.c:677 "You are %s (Rank %d) of %s\r\n" — rank>0 with no clan: C indexes clan[-1] (UB); "of a clan" line has no C source

You aren't holding that..evidence: src/act.other.c:933 "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n" — No zap verb in C; do_use's not-found branch says this ("holding" variant commented out at :939)

You see nothing but void..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/spells.c:935 — spell_mindsight returns silently on a bad location; look_at_room (act.informative.c:725) has no void branch

You tumble out into a strange place....segment: You tumble out into a strange place...
You tumble out into a strange place....evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1672 "\r\nWith a blinding flash of light and a crack of thunder, $n " — C tells only the room $n appears and gives the victim do_look; tumble line is Go-only

You write '.evidence: src/act.comm.c:1097 "Write your note.  End with '@' on a new line.\r\n" — C enters the string editor with this prompt; Go echoes the written text inline

You've been demoted within your clan!.segment: You've been demoted within your clan!
You've been demoted within your clan!.evidence: src/clan.c:487 "You've demoted within your clan!\r\n" — C omits "been"; Go silently corrects the typo

Your group leader is not online..segment: Your group leader is not online.
Your group leader is not online..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.other.c:649 — C print_group uses ch->master directly; no online check and no message

Your message was blocked..evidence: no C text; nearest: src/act.comm.c:901 — C do_tell has no word-filter gate; Go's moderation manager (pkg/moderation) is new

Your note was lost. (internal error).evidence: no C text; nearest: src/modify.c:173 — C's unknown-origin write abort is a SYSERR log, never player text

Zap who?.evidence: src/act.other.c:903 "What do you want to %s?\r\n" — No zap verb in C; do_use's no-argument branch prints this with CMD_NAME

[ FULL MOON RISES ] The full moon casts.segment: [ FULL MOON RISES ] The full moon casts an eerie glow across the land.
[ FULL MOON RISES ] The full moon casts.evidence: src/new_cmds.c:1322 "The lunar light infuses your body, forcing you to " — C full_moon only force-transforms flagged vampires/werewolves; the global broadcast is Go-only

[Broadcast].evidence: src/comm.c:2545 "&RBroadcast: %s&n" — C's broadcast prefix is red Broadcast: ; Go writes [Broadcast]

attacks you for.evidence: src/fight.c:931 "$n #W you hard." — C dam_message victim line for 7-10 damage, #W from attack type; Go prints a damage count

hits you, but it doesn't hurt!.segment: hits you, but it doesn't hurt!
hits you, but it doesn't hurt!.evidence: src/fight.c:907 "$n tries to #w you, but misses." — C dam_message dam==0 victim line; Go re-words it as a hit that does not hurt

says 'I don't like you, and you'd better.evidence: src/spec_procs2.c:1417 "$n exclaims, 'Dirty Orange Scum!'" — C ira exclaims this before hit(); Go substitutes a leave-or-I-attack line

says 'You're an evil one! That won't be.evidence: no C text; nearest: src/spec_procs2.c:1342 — C evillead only handles a give of cheese 13100 and teleports the giver; no alignment attack
